description: This source file defines a custom Android UI component class called CheckableFrameLayout, which extends FrameLayout and implements the Checkable interface. It provides functionality to be in a checked state, visually indicated by changing the background color.

classes.name: CheckableFrameLayout
classes.description: A custom FrameLayout that implements the Checkable interface, allowing it to maintain and toggle a checked state with a visual indicator.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Sets the checked state and updates the background color accordingly.
